¡Dale gas por el Orinoco! Carreras de la: Full throttle down the Orinoco! Outboard boat races: hold the throttle, jump the Atures rapids, dodge the caimans and let the turbo rip.
¡En Puerto Ayacucho! Esperando a tus pan: In Puerto Ayacucho! Waiting for your friends.
¡Remolino! Acelera hacia afuera; por el: Whirlpool! Speed to the outside; along the edge the current carries you.
¡Se ahogó el motor! Ya arranca otra vez…: The engine stalled! Starting up again…
Turbo ready! Space on a straight.
Atajo del igapó: corto, angosto y lleno: Flooded-forest shortcut: short, narrow and full of logs.
Busca el chorro: el agua rápida llena el: Find the fast current: fast water fills the turbo.
Cae derecho de los raudales o se te ahog: Land straight off the rapids or your engine stalls.
The host changed. The race goes on.
Del Caño del Sipapo a los raudales de At: From Caño del Sipapo to the Atures rapids and down the open Orinoco to Puerto Ayacucho. Hold the throttle, jump the rapids and dodge the caimans.
El chorro, los saltos derechos y la este: The fast current, straight jumps and the river dolphins' wake fill the turbo.
En el Orinoco las boyas marcan el canal:: On the Orinoco the buoys mark the channel: coral on the left, green on the right.
La próxima es tuya. Sostén el acelerador: The next one is yours. Hold the throttle and follow the arrows.
Raudal adelante: el carril rápido salta: Rapids ahead: the fast lane jumps higher. Land straight!
Río abierto: pasa entre las boyas y sigu: Open river: pass between the buoys and follow the golden arrows.
Sigue las flechas doradas en el agua: ma: Follow the golden arrows on the water: they mark the fast current, the quick lane through the rapids and steer clear of the caimans.
Sostén W para acelerar. No lo machaques:: Hold W to accelerate. Don't mash it: holding it is faster.
Sostén W todo el tiempo: machacarlo hace: Hold W the whole time: mashing it makes the boat slower.
